findings.text: blocking: the two-level tree reads the decision answer at the wrong level, so in production it decides nothing and every path falls to chat. decide_batch returns results[i] = (answers, cost) where answers is keyed by question name (imas_codex/discovery/base/judgment.py:262-266; _validate_decisions_answers at imas_codex/discovery/base/llm.py:3343 does answers.get(name)). The tree instead does `answer = result[0]` then `answer.get("choice")` (:1080) and `_ranked_probabilities(answer)` (:1058 -> :958 `answer.get("probabilities")`), reading those keys at the top level when they live under answers[CATEGORY_QUESTION] / answers[DOMAIN_QUESTION]. The retired flat classifier this node was told to port kept the unwrap (git show e0390840:imas_codex/graph/dd_domain_classifier.py:737-738 `answers.get(DOMAIN_QUESTION)`) and every current consumer does too (imas_codex/ids/candidates.py:383 answers["ids_routing"].get("probabilities")). Without it _ranked_probabilities returns [] so _beamed_categories returns [] and no second-level question is ever asked; every decision stays None and _route_below_threshold sends every path to chat. The 416-line tree is inert in production while the stubbed tests stay green.

blocking: the ScriptedDecisions stub returns a flattened `({"choice": ..., "probabilities": ...}, cost)` per state, a shape decide_batch never returns; the owner returns `({question_name: {"choice": ..., "probabilities": ...}}, cost)`. Every added assertion is therefore satisfied by the stub's own shape rather than by the code's read of the real contract, so all 17 tests pass with the production read broken (see the finding at imas_codex/graph/dd_domain_classifier.py:1080). A stub that encodes the owner's documented shape would redden the suite on the current code.

follow-on: the done_when asks that both option levels fail when the vocabulary gains a domain, but only the category level carries a recorded red run (negative_control_frozen_categories.log, EXIT=1 on test_category_options_follow_the_vocabulary_not_a_frozen_list). The second-level guard test_domain_options_are_exactly_that_categorys_domains_with_their_guidance (tests/graph/test_dd_domain_classifier_jev.py:260) has no recorded negative control.
